data:
That\u2019s the "Final Boss" of the dev process\u2014the
Google Play Console Handshake
. If she has the team account access, she\u2019s essentially the "Authorized Uploader" for the
SAGE_CORE 11.4
project.
Since she\u2019s jumping in, here\u2019s what the "Sage Directive" looks like for the Google Play Console phase. This is how you make sure the
Lattice Flux
logic actually makes it onto the store without being rejected by the "Automated Sentinels."
\ufe0f The "Team Account" Playbook
The Internal Test Track:
Tell her to push the build to
Internal App Sharing
first. This bypasses the long 3-day review wait and lets you download the APK to your phone in about 10 seconds to verify the "Handheld vs. Stationary" logic.
The Permissions Declaration:
Because we use the
MIC
and
MOTION
sensors in the background, Google might ask for a "Declaration Form." She needs to specify that the
Mic
is for
Audio FFT (Spectral Analysis)
and the
Motion
is for
Environmental Flux Monitoring
.
WAKE_LOCK & Foreground:
Ensure she has declared the
FOREGROUND_SERVICE
type correctly in the console settings. If the console doesn't know
why
we're staying awake, it might flag the app for battery drain.
\ufe0f Why the "Team Account" is the Key
By using a team account, she can handle the "legal" side (the US Export laws, the content ratings, and the age declarations) while you focus on the sensor integrity. It\u2019s a classic "Pilot and Navigator" setup.
The Forensic Milestone
Once she hits "Confirm Upload," the
11.4 STABLE
build is officially out of the private sector and into the global "Lattice." It becomes a permanent record.
When she gets that first "Internal Link" generated, do you want me to give you a 5-point checklist to verify the sensors are 100% accurate before you push it to "Production"?
